Mechanical properties and bioactivity of customized titanium alloy implants based on TPMS gradient technology: An in vivo study.

High AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Direct Read now animal Exp. validation Patient-specific
Huilin Hu, Haichuan Sun, Ziming Ma, Ziyi Zhang, Yilin Chen et al. Dental materials : official publication of the Academy of Dental Materials 2026-08-19 10.1016/j.dental.2026.08.007
单位: School of Preclinical Medicine and School of Nursing, Clinical Medical College & Affiliated Hospital of Chengdu University, Chengdu, China.
通讯: Lijia Cheng @ School of Preclinical Medicine and School of Nursing, Clinical Medical College & Affiliated Hospital of Chengdu Universi  |  Liuxing He @ School of Preclinical Medicine and School of Nursing, Clinical Medical College & Affiliated Hospital of Chengdu Universi
相关性: 该论文直接研究了基于TPMS梯度结构的钛合金植入物，结合力学性能与体内骨整合，与AM生物医学材料方向高度相关。
边界: 该论文未涉及疲劳性能测试，也未报告表面粗糙度或as-built形态对骨整合的影响。
动机· 优化定制牙种植体的多孔结构设计，以改善骨缺损修复效果。
方法· 通过有限元分析比较四种TPMS结构，选出Gyroid，并制备三种梯度/均匀孔隙率植入体，进行力学与体内实验。
结果· G50梯度Gyroid植入体力学性能最接近自然骨，且体内骨整合效果最佳。
验证· 采用压缩测试、抗菌实验及小鼠股骨缺损模型进行验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To optimize the porous architecture of customized dental implants for enhanced bone defect repair.
Method· Finite element analysis compared four TPMS structures, selecting Gyroid; three Ti-6Al-4V implants with gradient or uniform porosity were fabricated via 3D printing and evaluated.
Result· The G50 gradient Gyroid implant exhibited mechanical properties closest to natural bone and superior in vivo osseointegration.
Validation· Validation included compression testing, antibacterial assays, and a mouse femoral defect model with micro-CT and histology.

相关性: 该论文对多种神经网络PDE求解器进行了比较和误差分析，可为开发面向生物力学有限元代理模型的方法选择提供参考。
边界: This paper does not apply the solvers to biomedical or implant mechanics problems, nor does it address surrogate modeling for expensive simulations or uncertainty quantification.
动机· 比较多种深度学习PDE求解器的性能，并分析误差来源。
方法· 对PINN、WAN、DRM和VPINN进行数值实验对比，并给出误差分析。
结果· 发现损失函数形式和优化方法对求解精度影响显著，各方法各有优劣。

Motivation· This study aims to systematically compare several deep learning-based PDE solvers and analyze their error behavior to guide method selection.
Method· The authors conduct numerical experiments on PINN, WAN, DRM, and VPINN, and provide a rigorous error analysis for PINN with brief estimates for others.
Result· The results highlight the critical role of loss formulation and optimization strategy in achieving high accuracy, with no single solver universally superior.
Validation· The solvers are validated on standard numerical benchmarks, comparing accuracy and convergence across different problem settings.

通讯: Mohsen Mokhtari Kashavar @ Faculty of Architecture and Urbanism, Tabriz Islamic Art University, Tabriz, 5164736931, Iran  |  Yaser Shahbazi @ Faculty of Architecture and Urbanism, Tabriz Islamic Art University, Tabriz, 5164736931, Iran  |  Siamak Pedrammehr @ Faculty of Design, Tabriz Islamic Art University, Tabriz, 5164736931, Iran
相关性: 该论文展示了基于有限元仿真数据训练代理模型的方法，对用户构建生物力学FEA代理模型具有方法上的借鉴意义，但未涉及植入物或生物力学背景。
边界: This paper does not address implant mechanics, biomechanical context, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on structural health monitoring of space frames with point predictions only.
动机· 为空间框架结构快速评估提供仿真代理模型，避免大量有限元计算。
方法· 结合Grasshopper-Karamba3D生成数据集，比较多种机器学习模型并采用CNN-LSTM集成预测质量与位移。
结果· CNN-LSTM集成在质量预测上R²=0.9985，位移预测R²=0.7542，但未全面优于梯度提升树。
验证· 基于28,297个仿真样本的数值基准测试，无实验验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To enable rapid structural response assessment of space frame structures without expensive finite element simulations, this study develops a simulation-based surrogate modeling framework.
Method· A parametric workflow integrating Grasshopper-Karamba3D FEA generates a large labeled dataset, and multiple machine learning models including XGBoost, LightGBM, CNN, LSTM, and a CNN-LSTM ensemble are trained to predict mass and maximum displacement.
Result· The CNN-LSTM ensemble achieves the best overall performance with R² of 0.9985 for mass and 0.7542 for displacement, though gradient-boosted trees remain strong baselines.
Validation· The models are validated on a held-out test set from the same simulation dataset, with no experimental or physical validation.

Wenpeng Bian, Heng Cheng, Guangming Chen, Zhihong Wang, Peng Zhang et al. Scientific Reports 2026-08-06 10.1038/s41598-026-61156-8
单位: China Institute of Water Resources and Hydropower Research, Beijing, 100038, China
通讯: Heng Cheng @ China Institute of Water Resources and Hydropower Research, Beijing, 100038, China
相关性: 该论文展示了图神经网络代理模型结合物理约束优化进行多区域参数反演的方法，可迁移至植入物生物力学中的材料参数识别或代理建模。
边界: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics applications, lacks uncertainty quantification, and focuses on dam engineering rather than biomedical FEA surrogate modeling.
动机· 解决超高拱坝多区域弹性模量反演中有限元计算昂贵且传统神经网络难以处理非结构化网格的问题。
方法· 构建基于有限元网格的图神经网络代理模型，结合物理约束和粒子群优化进行多区域弹性模量反演。
结果· 代理模型预测误差小，有限元验证最大绝对变形误差为0.9550毫米，证明了框架的可行性。
验证· 通过工程案例的有限元仿真验证代理模型精度。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To address the high computational cost of finite element forward analyses and the limitations of conventional neural networks in handling unstructured mesh topology for multi-zone elastic modulus inversion in ultra-high arch dams.
Method· A graph neural network surrogate built on the finite element mesh is coupled with physics-constrained optimization using particle swarm optimization to invert multi-zone elastic moduli.
Result· The surrogate achieved a low objective value and finite element verification showed a maximum absolute hydrostatic deformation error of 0.9550 mm, demonstrating the feasibility of the framework.
Validation· The approach was validated through a simulation case study of an engineering arch dam, comparing surrogate predictions with finite element results.

相关性: 该论文将强化学习与进化策略结合用于电机参数辨识，并通过有限元仿真验证，其混合优化方法可迁移至生物力学有限元模型的参数校准或代理模型训练。
边界: This paper does not involve biomedical implants, biomechanics, or FEA-based design optimization; it focuses on electrical motor parameter identification with FEM validation only as a verification tool.
动机· 提高直线感应电机参数辨识的精度与鲁棒性。
方法· 提出强化学习与进化策略混合框架，联合估计电机关键参数。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To improve the accuracy and robustness of parameter identification for long-primary double-sided linear induction motors, which is critical for control performance and efficiency.
Method· A hybrid framework combining reinforcement learning and evolution strategies is proposed to jointly estimate stator resistance, leakage inductance, and end-effect coefficient.
Result· The hybrid method achieves a root mean square error of approximately 3.8e-4, outperforming standalone RL and ES by factors of 4.5 and 3, respectively, with convergence within about 50 episodes.
Validation· The identified parameters are validated against a high-fidelity finite element electromagnetic model, showing strong agreement, and robustness is confirmed under noise levels up to 0.05.

相关性: 该论文展示了将有限元仿真与代理模型结合预测感应淬火深度的方法，其代理建模和不确定性量化策略可迁移至植入物力学仿真中的高效采样与预测。
边界: This paper does not address biomedical implant mechanics, stress shielding, or bone-implant interface; it focuses on induction hardening of wind turbine bearings, lacking direct relevance to FEA surrogate for implant design.
动机· 风电转盘轴承需足够淬硬层深度以承受高接触应力，但仿真成本高。
方法· 结合电磁-热-相变耦合有限元与代理模型（DNN、RSM、GPR、SVR），以气隙和电流为输入预测淬硬层深度。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Large slewing bearings in wind turbines demand adequate hardening depth to withstand high contact stresses, yet simulation-based prediction is computationally expensive.
Method· A surrogate modeling approach combining electromagnetic-thermal-phase-transition coupled FEA with DNN, RSM, GPR, and SVR was developed to predict hardening depth from air gap and inductor currents.
Result· The DNN surrogate predicted a hardening depth of 6.17 mm under selected conditions, closely matching prototype measurement of 6.20 mm (2.90% difference).
Validation· Model performance was assessed via leave-one-out cross-validation, and the final prediction was validated against additional FEA and prototype measurements.

Motivation· To investigate the influence of bio-inspired laser texturing on the surface morphology and corrosion resistance of DMLS Ti-6Al-4V alloy for biomedical applications.

边界: This paper does not link porous structures to stress shielding or stiffness matching for implants, nor does it report fatigue, surface roughness, or osseointegration.
动机· 探索随机性对增材制造多孔结构力学性能的影响。
方法· 制备周期、随机TPMS及旋节线结构，进行压缩和三点弯曲实验与数值模拟。

Motivation· This study aims to investigate the influence of stochastic microstructural orientation on the mechanical response of sheet-based cellular metamaterials fabricated by additive manufacturing.
Method· Periodic and stochastic TPMS structures (Gyroid, Diamond) and spinodal structures were generated, fabricated from 316L stainless steel, and tested under uniaxial compression and three-point bending, with accompanying finite element simulations.
Result· Periodic TPMS structures exhibited up to 58% higher compressive yield strength and 51% higher flexural strength than stochastic counterparts, while stochastic TPMS outperformed spinodal structures.
Validation· Numerical predictions for stochastic structures were validated against experimental compression and bending tests, showing good agreement.

动机· 预测潮汐影响下的平衡海滩剖面，以支持海岸管理。
方法· 提出MorphoGP框架，用对比学习聚类海滩形态，每个类别训练高斯过程专家，并通过门控网络集成预测。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Accurate prediction of equilibrium beach profiles under tidal influence is essential for coastal management, yet existing models struggle with nonlinear interactions and adaptability across diverse environments.
Method· MorphoGP employs a contrastive-learning-based clustering to categorize beach morphologies, then trains specialized Gaussian process experts per category, integrated by a probabilistic gating network.
Result· On over 180 beach profiles from the Chinese coast, MorphoGP reduced test RMSE by approximately 59.3% compared to the best baseline, achieving an RMSE of 0.297 m.
Validation· The framework was validated using field data from tide-influenced coastal profiles, demonstrating superior predictive performance over conventional and deep learning baselines.

Motivation· The paper aims to tighten regret bounds for time-varying Gaussian process bandits by allowing a constant exploration parameter, unlike prior analyses that require it to grow with the horizon.

Result· For squared exponential kernels, it achieves an average regret of O(ε^{1/4}) in the persistent-drift regime, with a logarithmic dependence of the exploration parameter on 1/ε.
Validation· Simulations corroborate the predicted logarithmic scaling of the exploration parameter with the inverse drift rate.

Motivation· To investigate whether socioeconomic disadvantage is associated with worse postoperative outcomes after primary total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A retrospective cohort study using the TriNetX database, stratifying patients by presence of SDoH Z-codes and applying 1:1 propensity score matching to compare short- and long-term complications.

相关性: 该论文提出的导数观测增强PINN方法可迁移至生物力学代理建模中的参数识别问题，但未涉及植入物或生物医学应用。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Standard PINNs suffer from ill-posedness in identifying parameters of second-order oscillators because distinct parameter sets can yield nearly identical displacement records.
Method· The paper introduces D-PINN, which augments the training loss with velocity measurements, and provides theoretical guarantees via Sobolev-type inequalities, Fisher information analysis, and residual-based error bounds.
Result· Experiments on linear, forced near-resonance, and Duffing oscillators show that D-PINN reduces damping coefficient relative error from 40% to 11.7% without priors, and to 2.1% with a weak prior, a 19-fold improvement over standard PINN.
Validation· Validation is performed through numerical benchmarks on three oscillator types with multiple random seeds and extensive training epochs.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To overcome the scarcity of experimental data in structural repair applications by developing a data-efficient framework that integrates finite element simulations with machine learning for accurate failure load prediction.
Method· A FE-augmented ML framework was proposed, where high-fidelity FE models generated additional training data, and ten regression models (including GP, XGBoost, and KANs) were trained under leakage-free nested cross-validation with optional GMM-based synthetic augmentation.
Result· The best models achieved mean absolute percentage errors of 2.78% (patched) and 3.33% (unpatched) on unseen configurations, while ablation showed that GMM augmentation did not improve accuracy and often degraded it.
Validation· The approach was validated using experimental quasi-static tests on aluminum and steel specimens with composite patches at multiple temperatures, and FE predictions were confirmed to match experimental results closely.

Motivation· The coupled GTN fracture model is computationally expensive, hindering its use in large-scale finite element simulations of steel structures.
Method· A two-stage artificial neural network (TS-ANN) is proposed, which decouples material parameter mapping from stress-state dependence, trained on 49,875 single-element GTN simulations.

Motivation· Accurate inference of wall shear stress from passive scalar observations remains challenging, motivating the development of robust inverse frameworks.

边界: 该论文未涉及生物医学植入物、应力遮挡或接触力学，且无实验验证，仅针对振动控制结构。

Motivation· Conventional concave acoustic black hole designs compromise structural strength, motivating a convex ring-shaped configuration that preserves vibration reduction while enhancing integrity.
Method· A finite element model of the ring-shaped convex ABH plate was built, and a Kriging surrogate model coupled with a multi-objective genetic algorithm was used to optimize geometric parameters.
Result· The optimized design reduced mean peak kinetic energy density by 16.53% and achieved a maximum vibration reduction of 28.26 dB at around 1270 Hz.
Validation· The model accuracy was verified via mesh independence testing, and the optimization framework was validated through parametric studies and comparison with baseline.

Motivation· To address the computational challenge of predicting nanofluid heat transfer in complex TPMS geometries across varying concentrations and operating conditions.

Motivation· This study aimed to compare periprosthetic bone remodeling and clinical outcomes between conservative metaphyseal-fitting and conventional anatomic cementless femoral stems in young THA patients.

边界: This paper does not address engineering simulation, FEA, biomechanics, or any physical system; it is a theoretical AI safety resource allocation model.
动机· 分析AI安全系统中性格塑造与规则执行的资源分配如何随规模变化。
方法· 建立比较静态模型，参数化分配系数，结合蒙特卡洛模拟进行尾部风险分析。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The paper aims to formalize the optimal balance between character shaping and rule enforcement in AI safety systems as deployment scale increases.
Method· A comparative-statics model parameterizes the resource allocation between the two approaches and incorporates scale-dependent degradation and fragility, with closed-form expected harm and Monte Carlo CVaR analysis.
Result· The optimal allocation shifts toward character shaping with scale, but the dominant factor is the baseline character fragility rate, not scale or tail severity.
Validation· The model is validated through Monte Carlo simulations across three scenarios, comparing expected harm and CVaR optima.

Method· A type 2 diabetic rat model was induced, and a subset of rats underwent forced running; titanium implants were placed in the proximal tibia to compare osseointegration among groups.
